concern_summary: Management of visibility and active states for both the New Expensify Tab and Expensify Classic tab, ensuring proper display and interactions based on user actions.
Functionalities related to interacting with the Expensify feature set, including saving data, managing card settings, and displaying appropriate buttons for user actions.
Submit buttons that handle user inputs for important tasks, including issuing new cards and submitting expense reports within the application.
Buttons designed for switching workspaces and user accounts, enabling seamless navigation and interaction with different environments within the application.
User action buttons that facilitate various interactions like submitting actions, inviting users, or performing bulk actions based on user selections.
Toggle switches used to manage activation states for various features, facilitating user control over feature accessibility and settings.
Management of radio button functionalities for tracking and updating user interactions, focusing on selection states and accessibility.
